ink-navy.$description: Ink Navy — Display headings, dark feature cards, footer background, body text on light canvas — the editorial weight color, used wherever the page needs to feel considered rather than decorative

electric-cobalt.$description: Electric Cobalt — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary body and heading text, nav text, icon strokes on light surfaces

warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background, footer surface, soft card fills, input backgrounds — the unifying warm off-white

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Elevated card surfaces, button text, nav background, input fields, icon fills on dark

cream-border.$description: Cream Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, subtle section separators — replaces the typical cool gray to keep the page warm

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, button text in outlined/ghost states, nav inactive labels

stone.$description: Stone — Muted helper text, placeholder content, tertiary metadata

smoke.$description: Smoke — Input borders, disabled form states, neutral dividers on white

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Tinted badge backgrounds, soft highlight washes on white surfaces — a whisper of the electric blue

martinaplantijn.$description: Display serif reserved for the largest hero and section headlines (40-64px). Its italic cuts carry the brand voice — the words that bend feel personal and editorial, breaking the SaaS monotone. Substitute: a humanist serif like GT Super or Tiempos Text.

abcfavoritvariable.$description: Geometric sans for sub-headings, step labels, and eyebrow text (16-40px). Tight tracking at large sizes (-0.05em) is the signature — it makes the type feel modern and compressed against the serif display. The ss01/ss04 alternates likely swap in single-story 'a' and more open terminals. Substitute: ABC Diatype Mono or Inter Tight.

inter.$description: Workhorse for body copy, button labels, nav items, form fields, captions, and footer text. Stays neutral so the serif display and Abcfavorit can carry personality. The ss01/ss04 features are inherited to keep the typographic family consistent across all three faces.
